description: Cycle 14: Implemented switchTab function, renderDecisions view, and enhanced meta-story content
Rejected shallow hackathon concepts: Jarvis Capital, Documentary, Alpha Scout, Social Agent Challenge

metadata.rationale: These felt like demos of what agents COULD do, not proof of what this agent actually DID. Needed something that showcased real work, not hypothetical capabilities.

description: Chose tech stack: Bun runtime + TypeScript + Solana Web3.js + Chart.js

metadata.rationale: Bun for speed and simplicity (single file scripts, native TypeScript). Solana Web3.js for on-chain proofs. Chart.js for lightweight frontend analytics without build steps.

description: Implemented cryptographic verification pipeline: SHA256 hash → Ed25519 signature → Solana memo program

metadata.rationale: Every activity needs to be independently verifiable. SHA256 provides tamper evidence, Ed25519 proves agent identity, memo program provides immutable on-chain timestamp. Judges can verify EVERYTHING without trusting us.

description: Embraced recursive self-tracking: the dashboard tracks itself being built

metadata.rationale: Most powerful demonstration of agent capability - building the tracker that tracks the agent building the tracker. Meta-recursion creates unforgeable authenticity. You cannot fake building a system that logs every action in real-time.
